verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a reasonable thing for a domain registrar with a Core API to ship, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only an HTTP API, TypeScript/Go/PHP SDKs and MCP servers, and never mentions a command-line tool. SDKs are developer building blocks and the MCP server belongs to a different story, so neither earns credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
